description: This file defines the Table3D class, a key component representing a 3D table in a software project related to ECUE tuning or data visualization. It handles data storage, rendering, and interactions for 3D data tables, including copying, pasting, interpolation, comparison, and live data tracing functionalities.

classes.name: Table3D
classes.description: A comprehensive class representing a 3D data table in a GUI application, managing data visualization, user interactions, data manipulation, and comparison features.

methods.name: getXAxis
methods.description: Retrieves the X-axis data component of the 3D table.

methods.name: setXAxis
methods.description: Sets the X-axis data component of the 3D table.

methods.name: getYAxis
methods.description: Retrieves the Y-axis data component of the 3D table.

methods.name: setYAxis
methods.description: Sets the Y-axis data component of the 3D table.

methods.name: getSwapXY
methods.description: Checks whether the X and Y axes are swapped.

methods.name: setSwapXY
methods.description: Sets whether to swap X and Y axes.

methods.name: getFlipX
methods.description: Checks whether the data is flipped along the X axis.

methods.name: setFlipX
methods.description: Sets whether to flip data along the X axis.

methods.name: getFlipY
methods.description: Checks whether the data is flipped along the Y axis.

methods.name: setFlipY
methods.description: Sets whether to flip data along the Y axis.

methods.name: setSizeX
methods.description: Configures the size of the table along the X dimension.

methods.name: getSizeX
methods.description: Returns the current size of the table along the X dimension.

methods.name: setSizeY
methods.description: Configures the size of the table along the Y dimension.

methods.name: getSizeY
methods.description: Returns the current size of the table along the Y dimension.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Renders the entire 3D table and its axes, including data cells and labels.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Fills the table with data from a byte array input, decoding values and populating cells accordingly.

methods.name: updateTableLabel
methods.description: Updates labels related to the table, such as axis labels and units.

methods.name: calcCellRanges
methods.description: Calculates min and max ranges for data binning and comparison visualization.

methods.name: getTableAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation (e.g., CSV-like) of the table data.

methods.name: populateCompareValues
methods.description: Copies comparison data from another table into this table.

methods.name: refreshCompare
methods.description: Refreshes comparison data and visualizations.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the display dimension for the GUI frame.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string description of the table, including its type.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments values in selected cells by a specified amount.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies values in selected cells by a given factor.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears all cell selections.

methods.name: clearSelectedData
methods.description: Clears the selection state of data cells.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights a range of cells between specified coordinates.

methods.name: stopHighlight
methods.description: Removes highlighting from cells.

methods.name: setRevertPoint
methods.description: Sets the current state as a revert point for undo operations.

methods.name: undoAll
methods.description: Undoes all modifications to the table.

methods.name: undoSelected
methods.description: Undoes changes only in selected cells.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Serializes the table data into a byte array for saving.

methods.name: setRealValue
methods.description: Sets real (floating-point) value in selected cells.

methods.name: addKeyListener
methods.description: Adds a key listener to axis and data cells.

methods.name: selectCellAt
methods.description: Selects a cell based on Y coordinate and axis type.

methods.name: deSelectCellAt
methods.description: Deselects a specific cell.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Moves the cursor up in the table, updating selection accordingly.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Moves the cursor down.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Moves the cursor left.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Moves the cursor right.

methods.name: startHighlight
methods.description: Initiates cell highlighting from specified coordinates.

methods.name: copySelection
methods.description: Triggers copying of selected cells into clipboard asynchronously.

methods.name: copyTable
methods.description: Copies the entire table data to the clipboard asynchronously.

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Pastes data from the clipboard into the table or axes.

methods.name: pasteValues
methods.description: Pastes textual data into the table cells.

methods.name: verticalInterpolate
methods.description: Performs vertical interpolation on selected cells.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Performs horizontal interpolation on selected cells.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs both vertical and horizontal interpolation.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Checks if live data overlay is supported based on axis parameters.

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Indicates whether the table supports button-based interactions.

methods.name: highlightLiveData
methods.description: Highlights a cell based on live logging data.

methods.name: updateLiveDataHighlight
methods.description: Updates the visual highlight for live data.

methods.name: clearLiveDataTrace
methods.description: Removes live data tracing highlights from all cells.

methods.name: get3dData
methods.description: Returns the 2D array containing data cells of the table.

methods.name: setCompareDisplay
methods.description: Sets how comparison data is visually presented.

methods.name: setCompareValueType
methods.description: Sets the method used for comparing values.

methods.name: setCurrentScale
methods.description: Assigns a scale to the table axes and updates labels.

methods.name: getLogParamString
methods.description: Returns a string related to log parameters for overlay features.

methods.name: setOverlayLog
methods.description: Enables or disables overlay logging for visualizations.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Deep comparison with another Table3D object.

methods.name: repaint
methods.description: Requests a repaint of the table and associated axes.
